detail.longDescription: "Learn to identify areas of your site where the human view differs from the agent view. One way is to compare the Markdown mirror of a page against the rendered HTML view and see if the content differs. Keep in mind that the mirror only approximates the agent view. Many agents fetch the HTML and convert it with their own converter, and their output can differ from your mirror. So also test the real path: ask an agent to fetch the page and tell you what’s in the table. That’s an easy way to catch problems like the ones in the tiered table above. You can also create a skill that does this same task. The skill looks at each page in your docs, compares it against the Markdown mirror, and flags any discrepancies. One caveat: not every agent reads text. Browser-using agents that work from screenshots will see the gray text. But the most common path today is fetch and convert, and that’s the path where styling disappears." https:// idratherbewriting.com/blog/ide ntify-semantics-in-styling-agents # TechnicalWriting # SoftwareDocumentation # AI # AIAgents # AgenticAI # WebDesign # WebDevelopment
